nodes.name: Interrupted RF Sputtering Deposition
nodes.procedure: WO3 thin films were deposited using rf sputtering with a tungsten target of 99.95% purity with a diameter of 100 mm and a thickness of 3.175 mm. The target to substrate distance was set to 70 mm. The substrate temperature was kept constant at room temperature during film deposition. The base pressure in the sputtering chamber was 6×10^-6 mbar. The sputtering atmosphere consisted of an Ar-O2 mixed gas with Ar:O2 flow ratio of 1:1. The pressure in the deposition chamber during sputtering was 5×10^-3 mbar. The rf sputtering power was 100 W and the deposition included three interruptions of 1.5 min each.
nodes.source_text: The first one included three interruptions of the deposition process. The rf sputtering power was 100 W and the interruption time was 1.5 min.

nodes.name: Floating Regime RF Sputtering Deposition
nodes.procedure: WO3 thin films were deposited using rf sputtering with a tungsten target of 99.95% purity with a diameter of 100 mm and a thickness of 3.175 mm. The target to substrate distance was set to 70 mm. The substrate temperature was kept constant at room temperature during film deposition. The base pressure in the sputtering chamber was 6×10^-6 mbar. The sputtering atmosphere consisted of an Ar-O2 mixed gas with Ar:O2 flow ratio of 1:1. The pressure in the deposition chamber during sputtering was 5×10^-3 mbar. The thin film was deposited with three interruptions. In the first two interruptions the sputtering power was 100 W and in the last one the sputtering power was set to 280 W.
nodes.source_text: The second one comprised a deposition by using a floating regime that included three interruptions as well. In the first two interruptions the sputtering power was 100 W and in the last one the sputtering power was set to 280 W.

nodes.name: Annealing of WO3 films
nodes.procedure: After deposition the thin films were annealed at 400°C during 2 h with modified heating rate of 10°C/min and cooling rate of 10°C/min.
